title: Burst Button
description: A real call-to-action that answers a click with a burst of sparks — feedback you can see from across the room.
usage: The button is an ordinary primary button; the burst is its click feedback, fired from the exact point of the click, in the token palette. Use it on the one action a page exists for — deploy, purchase, publish. A burst on every button is a fireworks stall; a burst on the button is punctuation.
a11y: The click still does its job with the script removed, and the burst is aria-hidden canvas. Under prefers-reduced-motion there is no burst — the button relies on its pressed state like its ancestors, which is sufficient because it is, first, a button.
